bugs.bug: safeNormalizeFileUrl treats process.execPath as a string, but under Deno it is a String object, so the typeof string check fails and a valid executable path is rejected
bugs.example: file-url.js: safeNormalizeFileUrl validates `typeof fileString !== 'string'` without unwrapping a boxed String, so a String-object execPath (as in Deno) is rejected as an invalid file argument
